Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.mfa

Class MfaPolicy

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.mfa.MfaPolicy
public class MfaPolicy extends Object
The rule that decides when the factors of an authentication are enough, and when they are required. It is pure: it knows nothing about sessions, requests or storage.

  • Method Details

    • isSatisfied

      public boolean isSatisfied(Set<AuthenticationFactor> factors)
      Tells whether a set of factors satisfies the sign-in policy: a FactorStrength.PRIMARY_STRONG factor alone, or a FactorStrength.PRIMARY factor together with a FactorStrength.SECOND or a FactorStrength.REMEMBERED one (a trusted device skips the second factor of a sign-in).
      Parameters:
      factors - the factors used by the authentication; must not be null.
      Returns:
      true when the factors are enough.

    • isReported

      public boolean isReported(AuthenticationFactor factor)
      Tells whether a factor proves something about the authentication it was presented in, and is therefore reported (amr, acr, auth_time) and counted by a step-up request. A FactorStrength.REMEMBERED factor is not: it only recalls a second factor presented earlier.
      Parameters:
      factor - the factor.
      Returns:
      true unless the factor is FactorStrength.REMEMBERED.

    • isPrimary

      public boolean isPrimary(AuthenticationFactor factor)
      Tells whether a factor is the primary one of an authentication, the one auth_time and max_age are measured from.
      Parameters:
      factor - the factor.
      Returns:
      true for a FactorStrength.PRIMARY or FactorStrength.PRIMARY_STRONG factor.

    • isRequired

      public boolean isRequired(boolean clientRequires, boolean userRequires)
      Tells whether multi-factor authentication is required, which is when either the client or the user demands it.
      Parameters:
      clientRequires - whether the client being served requires it.
      userRequires - whether the user's account requires it.
      Returns:
      true when a second factor is required.

    • hasStrength

      private static boolean hasStrength(Set<AuthenticationFactor> factors, FactorStrength strength)
      Tells whether any factor has a strength.
      Parameters:
      factors - the factors to inspect.
      strength - the strength to look for.
      Returns:
      true when at least one factor has that strength.
